answer: Compounding opportunity costs and non-refundable attestation fees create an escalating marginal cost curve for adversaries, as each staked collateral unit foregoes yield while slashing penalties grow super-linearly. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay locks commitments, rendering any Sybil fork computationally infeasible and yielding negative expected attack utility. The resulting game admits a robust Nash equilibrium where the mesa of attestations forms an orchard of verified identities and the signal of honest participation dominates deviation.
